title: Rules and repository reconciliation
description: Inspect repo and actual evidence; verify contest window/AI disclosure/chain requirement; preserve prior working state.
acceptance_criteria: Rules recorded and old task evidence reconciled; unresolved eligibility disclosed.

title: Local runtime and toolchain
description: Reuse installed Solana Skills/docs MCP and Anchor; build local validator, disposable 6-decimal test mint, funded accounts; timebox external setup, do not block UI on Devnet.
acceptance_criteria: Actual local runtime available or explicit blocker; isolated fallback labeled.

title: Registry and immutable assets
description: Reuse 8-instruction ABI; verify initializer and provider constraints, asset PDA and status.
acceptance_criteria: Actual registry and authorization tests pass.

title: Fixture store and trust
description: Import 12 unchanged fixtures and sidecars, immutable private bytes, deterministic metadata search and verified snapshot.
acceptance_criteria: 12 hashes match; source/schema labels, no raw body and gap works.

title: Atomic purchase and receipt
description: Two purchase_unit instructions in one actual local transaction; verify exact split and two PDAs; standalone unit for later resale.
acceptance_criteria: Actual -60000/+24000/+24000/+12000, two receipts, size and fee measured.

title: Critical payment negative tests
description: Wrong mint/ATA, second instruction fail, duplicate, expired/deactivated, insufficient balance; keep actual evidence.
acceptance_criteria: No partial movement/receipt or duplicate; network fees distinguished.

title: Quote and receipt-gated delivery
description: Preflight exact content/license and snapshot; quote, wallet challenge, finalized receipt gate, retry and recover.
acceptance_criteria: Unauthorized/mismatch blocked, exact recovery no second charge.

title: Deterministic purchase agent
description: Use typed facade search/quote/purchase/verify/retrieve; display actual trace and source facts.
acceptance_criteria: Actual tool calls, two receipts, no hardcoded success.

title: Bounty funding and submission
description: Use existing bounty PDA/vault, public requirement hash, inactive submission and bounded review.
acceptance_criteria: Funded OPEN, no payout on submit, invalid submission rejected.

title: Bounty accept and refund
description: Requester signs after deterministic review; accept receipt and split; separate expiry refund; wrong signer/replay/race negative cases.
acceptance_criteria: Actual payout 1.6/0.4 TEST; separate refund 2 TEST, no commission.

title: Gap-to-data and resale driver
description: Use gap to fund, accept, retrieve, activate and second buyer purchases via existing instruction.
acceptance_criteria: Full chain-backed lifecycle and new buyer receipt; distinct budget.

title: Polished guided browser UI
description: One browser guided journey with actual step state, balances, evidence, mode, error and reset; no new design framework.
acceptance_criteria: All scenes usable, no fake success or private prepay data.

title: Rehearse and verify
description: Two clean runs; local chain evidence, negative tests, isolated reset and fallback modes; optional Devnet only if ready.
acceptance_criteria: Technical and UX gates separately recorded; actual evidence manifest, no secret.

title: Freeze and deliver
description: Document exact commands, test results, limitations, screenshots; update pitch with actual proof if available; no unauthorized submission.
acceptance_criteria: Single-session handoff, truthful state, final rehearsal.

title: Optional x402 live compatibility
description: Reuse verified integration or short bounded spike only if core passes; otherwise direct Anchor with explicit not-connected/preview.
acceptance_criteria: Actual full atomic settlement via compatible x402 or clearly omitted.

title: Shared agent tools and spend guard
description: Implement typed tool facade and durable serialized cap; optional stdio MCP handshake if SDK ready; use same functions for deterministic driver.
acceptance_criteria: Actual calls and cap/replay/access tests, MCP state accurately labeled.

title: Optional external AI agent
description: Use installed external client only if available; actual tool trace or label deterministic. No new credentials or long setup.
acceptance_criteria: Actual external trace or explicit not-connected.

title: Post-event online product validation
description: AI desk research and opt-in product analytics; actual paid demand after legal approval.
acceptance_criteria: Document actual evidence, not AI estimates

title: Post-event commercial and scale review
description: Post-event commercial gates G5–G7: rent compression/batching, delivery/refund, bounty dispute/producer risk, rights, independent quality, actual demand and compliance. Use POST-HACKATHON-SCALING; no real sales without separate approval.
